header.running_head: 4. Virtues of the Dhikr of Allah...

blocks.tamil_translation: I come one cubit closer to him; if he comes one cubit closer to Me, I come two cubits closer to him; if he comes to Me walking, I come to him running.” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said that Allah says this.

blocks.text: Explanation:- That is, to whatever great extent a person gains My closeness through good deeds, I turn My attention towards him (show him compassion) with My grace and help even more than that.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: إِنَّ اللهَ يَقُولُ: أَنَا مَعَ عَبْدِي إِذَا هُوَ ذَكَرَنِي وَتَحَرَّكَتْ بِي شَفَتَاهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابن ماجه باب فضل الذكر رقم: ٣٧٩٢
blocks.tamil_translation: “When My servant remembers Me and his lips move in My remembrance, I am with him.” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said that Allah says this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ بُسْرٍ ﵁ أَنَّ رَجُلاً قَالَ: يَارَسُولَ اللهِ! إِنَّ شَرَائِعَ اْلإِسْلَامِ قَدْ كَثُرَتْ عَلَيَّ فَأَخْبِرْنِي بِشَيْءٍ أَتَشَبَّثُ بِهِ قَالَ: لَا يَزَالُ لِسَانُكَ رَطْباً مِّنْ ذِكْرِ اللهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقَالَ: هذا حديث حسن غريب باب ما جاء في فضل الذكر رقم: ٣٣٧٥
blocks.tamil_translation: A Sahabi asked, “Ya Rasulallah! The laws of the Shari'ah are many. (Acting according to them is certainly necessary), but tell me one deed that I can make my habit,” and Rasulullah ﷺ replied, “Let your tongue remain moist with the Dhikr of Allah at all times.” Hazrat Abdullah ibn Busr (RA) narrates this.
